title: Sticker category fetch is re-sent from render after a failed send; the Fetch never reaches Failed
trigger: Open the sticker tab while the TDLib sender is gone (send_json returns Err); sticker_category_strip sees sticker_categories.is_idle() every frame
effect: fetch_sticker_categories -> sticker_request fails, take()s the request and calls lists.for_purpose(GetStickerCategories), which is None, so sticker_categories stays Idle and is never marked Failed; every render defers another failing send and the category strip never shows or reports an error
